text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: That huge body you can see from here is definitely a white whale...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここからでも見えるあの巨体、
間違いなくシロクジラです……！

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: Yes, I was able to confirm it with Ram. ...I sense something even more unpleasant than before.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
ラムにも確認できたわ。
……さっきよりも不快な気配がするわね。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Let's hurry, Ram, Rem! Can I get a pack?
text_block_list.orig_text:
急ぎましょう
ラム、
レム！
パックもいい？

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: If it's for my cute daughter, I'd be happy to do it♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
可愛い娘のためなら
どんとこいだよ♪
